title: "RV2008: Resumed module exports a different binding under a captured name"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Cannot resume {component}: the module exports a different binding as `{name}` than the `{name}` its symbols reference; rename the local or the export
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Rename one binding: give the used value (an import or a module-scope local) another local name, or export the other binding under a different name. Covers `export { a as b }` next to a used local `b` and `export { a as b } from "./c"` next to a used import or local `b`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { x } from "./b";
export { y as x } from "./c";
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => x()} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { x } from "./b";
export { y as cx } from "./c";
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => x()} />; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode, server and DOM targets; no source range (span None).
